title: PaymentRunRequest
description: The input of payment.run: the lines of the run, in order, each the input of one payment.create, and nothing else. DSoR reads each line's amount and vendor from its invoice, and derives each line's key itself (step 41's README, decisions D5 and D6). The most lines a run may hold is its contract's batch.max_items, which line 6 checks after this schema, so the contract stays the one place it is declared (DSOR-BAT-01a). This tutorial's own schema: the specification names batches and does not define a run's input.
